items.text: — app theme picker; site light/dark + Dev Deck (Ctrl+Shift+D).
— light/dark mode; Dev Mode surprise tools (CDN ping, font map, accent shuffle).
— chopstickshq.com hub; full product site at getrnitro.netlify.app.
— releases on github.com/ilikemacos/rNitro with App ZIP, PKG, DMG, and .sh.

releases.title: v1.3.3 Experimental / v1.2.12 Beta / v1.2.9 Final
releases.body_html: Light & dark mode on website + app. Dev toolkit: site Dev Deck (CDN ping, grid, party mode); app Dev Mode environment manifest, font map, CDN ping, accent shuffle.

releases.title: v1.3.2 Experimental / v1.2.11 Beta / v1.2.8 Final
releases.body_html: Font picker UX — search fonts, filter Sans/Serif/Display/Script/Mono, star favorites, OFL credit. 50+ Google Fonts still offline.

releases.title: v1.3.1 Experimental / v1.2.10 Beta / v1.2.7 Final
releases.body_html: Version bump — same UI font library (50+ Google Fonts OFL). Patch release for channel versioning and distribution.

releases.title: v1.3.0 Experimental / v1.2.9 Beta / v1.2.6 Final
releases.body_html: UI font library — 50+ Google Fonts (OFL) in Appearance, including EB Garamond, Audiowide, and Caveat. Experimental 1.3.0 keeps all Lab toys; Beta 1.2.9 ships fonts + process tools; Stable 1.2.6 Final gets fonts without Lab.

releases.title: v1.2.7 Beta / Experimental
releases.body_html: Process tools + Dev Mode finish — Why hot?, kill/reveal (Dev), UI config JSON, Lab toys TOC collapsed. Gatekeeper guide on site.

releases.title: v1.2.0 Final (Stable)
releases.body_html: Stable catch-up — customizable UI + ⌘Q from modern builds; OpenAI/OpenRouter only; no Lab. GitHub.

releases.title: v1.2.6 Experimental
releases.body_html: New Lab toys — thermal forecast, heat haiku, throttle cosplay, overnight watch, core roulette, chaos blip. Beta keeps slim Lab.

releases.title: v1.2.5 Beta / Experimental
releases.body_html: Customizable UI + Developer Mode — menubar builder, density, accents, thresholds for everyone; optional Dev tools for sampling/logs/dumps. GitHub.

releases.title: v1.2.4 Beta / Experimental
releases.body_html: Patched a bug — ⌘Q now quits the menu bar app. Lab crash fix (scrub slider) + Experimental Features sidebar.

releases.title: v1.2.3 Beta
releases.body_html: Beta — Lab: AirDrop card, SOC budget, cooling confession, desktop widget, rnitro lab status.

releases.title: v1.1.0 Final Reloaded
releases.body_html: Stable channel — production-ready menu bar monitor for daily use. AI limited to OpenAI + OpenRouter.

releases.title: Platform notes
releases.body_html: macOS — Apple Silicon, macOS 12+. Linux — v0.1 pre-release. Windows — deprecated.

compare.title: Stable vs Beta — which should I download?
compare.subtitle: Start with Stable v1.2.0 Final (App ZIP). Beta v1.2.6 adds Lab, Developer Mode, and every AI provider.

rows.beta: Lab, Dev Mode, every AI provider

rows.stable: Appearance, Menubar (density/slots), Monitor, Alerts, General + custom UI
rows.beta: Same + Lab + Developer Mode + full AI list
Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LM Studio, Ollama, Hermes
